description: This source file provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments, classifying targets, and constructing test run plans for Vitest within a testing framework. It primarily manages configuration and execution plans for different test suites, including support for various project modules and extensions.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes in a file path pattern.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given filesystem path exists.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given filesystem path exists and is a file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Detects if the input string contains glob pattern syntax.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Checks if the filename matches common test file naming conventions.

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument appears to be a valid path, glob, or test file pattern.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts a path argument to a repo-relative normalized pattern.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Generates an include pattern for test files based on a path argument.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a target argument into specific test category types based on its path and name.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for executing Vitest with specified parameters.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine target test files and modes, like watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Creates a set of plan objects defining how different test targets should be run with configurations.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Produces configurations for executing test plans, including environment variables and include patterns.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes include patterns to a JSON file for Vitest to consume.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Builds final command-line arguments for Vitest based on the provided test arguments.
